technicalNotes:
When found in the Eos Roof Electronics:
This fault code is most likely flagged when control module is unable to determine the position of the top based on data from the sensors.  Please see VW Eos (1F) Convertible Top for information.
If sensor data in MVB 002 is correct for top position, note that the J657 "Door Closing Assist Control Module" may have an issue.  This is the adjustable striker on the body of the vehicle for the rear lid.
